invariants.rationale: All return statements provide non-null arrays of AssetDescriptor via getDependencies; exceptions are thrown on invalid input, so null is never returned.
Method would throw or behave incorrectly if 'file' were null; used for extension and passed to other loaders.
'file.extension()' is called to determine map type, so it cannot be null at this point.
'result' is an Array object, which always has a non-negative size.
Only 'tmx' and 'tmj' extensions reach a return statement; other extensions throw an exception.
